messages:
maria: quick sync — post-launch grooming for the next 2w iteration. We need a lightweight rule-set to decide bugfix vs enhancement. propose 3 quick gates so we can freeze scope by EOD Fri.

jordan: +1. can you drop the telemetry links? want to see error surface before we tag anything.

maria: dashboard: https://dash.redd.infra/postlaunch/errors (filter: last 48h). main asks: customer blockers, regression P99 spikes, and any billing-impacting issues.

sam: FYI infra capacity looks ok for 2 small hotfixes + 1 medium feature. but if we add more CI->release churn we may hit a freeze.

olivia: small UX polish for streaming UI — low risk, but needs design sign-off (30m). could be slotted if no P0s.

ben: suggest we reserve 20% of squad velocity for urgent rollbacks and reverts. keeps the dev flow predictable. :thumbsup:

maria: proposed gates (short):
```
1) P0 bug = customer-blocker or data-loss -> auto in next sprint.
2) P1 bug -> qualifies if>5 customers impacted OR metric delta >=3% across cohort.
3) UX/feature asks = include only if scoped to <=3 engineer-days OR tied to a paid customer visit.
```

jordan: sounds reasonable. for P1 detection I can add an alert rule: `alert.postlaunch.p1` that samples a 24h window and emits candidate tickets.

dev-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout for release/1.3.2 completed — 12% traffic, no regressions observed. Logs: `/var/logs/deploy/1.3.2/canary.log`

sam: quick nit: for urgent fixes please include a `rollback-plan` field in PR description and run `./perf-check --batch 16` before merging. saves us surprises.

maria: agreement: owners for triage this week = jordan (eng), olivia (design), eva (support) to validate customer severity. I'll label tickets `postlaunch/next2w` + `prio:fix|enh`.

eva: support: I'll surface 3 customers who reported streaming disconnects and confirm repro steps.

ben: if we get >2 P1s we should consider a small patch release vs cramming into main sprint.

maria: plan of action: 1) Jordan to run alert rule and paste candidate list by tomorrow 11am. 2) Eva to confirm customer impact for those. 3) Triage meeting 11:30am, Thursday — quick owners and estimates. freeze scope Fri EOD.

jordan: I’ll own the alert and post the list.

olivia: I can do design quickcheck Thursday after triage.

sam: will queue CI and reserve the 20% velocity buffer.

maria: thanks — please react with :eyes: if you can make the 11:30 Thu triage. If no major objections I’ll post the sprint decision after freeze.

ben: :eyes:

olivia: :eyes:

eva: :eyes:

jordan: :eyes:
